quickAnswer: With three full days in Chongqing, use one day for Jiefangbei, the river-confluence area, and Hongya Cave after dark; one for Liziba and the Three Gorges Museum; and one for Ciqikou or a focused day trip. Chongqing is a vertical mountain city, so a short distance on a map can hide steep stairs, several road levels, or an entrance on a different floor. Group stops by both district and elevation, save each destination in Chinese, and leave room for finding the correct entrance, pickup point, and viewing level. Before fixing Day 2, use the museum closure and entry checks below; at Liziba, allow separately for riding the monorail and photographing it from outside.
lizibaNote: Ride Chongqing Rail Transit Line 2 to Liziba. A ride through the station and the exterior train-through-building photo are separate experiences; use the designated viewing platform for the latter, following current signs.
museumNote: Continue to the Chongqing China Three Gorges Museum main venue at 236 Renmin Road, Yuzhong. Check the Monday alternative and entry details above before setting this day, then choose the galleries that interest you.

items: Visitor details checked October 22, 2026 against the museum announcement published by the municipal culture and tourism commission and the city government visitor guide. Holiday arrangements, crowd controls and temporary closures can change.

For a Sunday–Tuesday visit, keep the central peninsula on Sunday, use Monday for Ciqikou and a slower neighbourhood day, then visit Liziba and the museum on Tuesday. This exchanges the original Day 2 and city-based Day 3; it does not add a fourth day.

If Day 3 is already a fixed Dazu or Wulong excursion, choose another open museum slot before booking it. If your only available museum day is a closed Monday, use a city or food alternative instead of assuming the galleries will open.

Foreign visitors should carry the passport used for the trip and allow time for staff document checks. The main-museum announcement does not make every affiliated venue free or remove their separate ticket requirements.

items: The city government confirms that Liziba is on Line 2 and has a dedicated exterior viewing platform. Decide whether you want the ride, the photo or both before choosing your stopping point.

The museum visitor guide lists Zengjiayan on Line 2 and Niujiaotuo on Line 3 as rail approaches. Using Zengjiayan keeps the Liziba-to-museum rail leg on Line 2, followed by a walk; the museum is not inside the station.
Use current station and street signs for the viewing platform and museum approach. If stairs or slopes are difficult, choose a point-to-point ride and confirm the museum entrance.

faqs.question: Do I need to reserve the Three Gorges Museum in advance?
faqs.answer: The museum announcement published November 3, 2025 says its main museum no longer requires advance reservations and admits visitors with valid identification. Carry your passport, allow time for document checks and check later temporary notices. Affiliated venues can have separate ticket requirements.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Chongqing museum day falls on Monday?
faqs.answer: The main museum normally closes on Mondays except national statutory holidays. For a Sunday–Tuesday trip, use Sunday for the central peninsula, Monday for Ciqikou and neighbourhoods, and Tuesday for Liziba and the museum. If an excursion is already fixed, choose a different open museum slot or use a city alternative.

faqs.question: How do I combine Liziba with the Three Gorges Museum?
faqs.answer: Use Line 2 for Liziba, allowing separate time for the exterior viewing platform if you want the train-through-building photo. Continue on Line 2 to Zengjiayan and follow the walking route to the main museum at 236 Renmin Road, Yuzhong. Check current direction and street signs and allow for hills.
